fields.name: rownum
fields.doc: 1-based physical line number within the source object.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.doc: UTC instant captured from the line header, at microsecond resolution. Capture context, and only that: it is the clock the bridge stamped the *line* with, so it dates no message and never reaches one. What dates a message is what the message states -- its `TransactTime`, else its `SendingTime`, else the one instant the codec is pinned with -- so the same bytes logged at three hops settle on one instant however each line was stamped.

fields.name: timepartition
fields.doc: Timestamp partitioned by its UTC hour in Iceberg. `logs.messages` is laid out by it and `fix.messages` carries it as an ordinary column: a settled message is laid out by the instant it happened at, not by the instant a bridge printed the line.

fields.name: threadId
fields.doc: Bridge thread identifier captured from the line header.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: Severity spelling captured from the line header.

fields.name: unix
fields.doc: When the message happened: the settled instant, UTC.

fields.name: creatunix
fields.doc: When the message was created: what it states, else when the original was sent, else when it happened; the earliest its chain knows once followed.

fields.name: prevunix
fields.doc: When the message this one follows happened, where it follows one.

fields.name: expirunix
fields.doc: When the message stops being good: ExpireTime, else ValidUntilTime, else ExpireDate, else the instrument's MaturityDate.

fields.name: snapunix
fields.doc: The grid instant a walk read this message as the snapshot of; empty on every row no snapshot was taken of.

fields.name: recordedat
fields.doc: The instant the capture recorded this line: the line's own text timestamp, else SendingTime.

fields.name: sendingtime
fields.doc: Time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

fields.name: origsendingtime
fields.doc: Original time of message transmission (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT") when transmitting orders as the result of a resend request.

fields.name: transacttime
fields.doc: Timestamp when the business transaction represented by the message occurred.

fields.name: settldate
fields.doc: Specific date of trade settlement (SettlementDate) in YYYYMMDD format.

fields.name: tradedate
fields.doc: Indicates date of trading day. Absence of this field indicates current day (expressed in local time at place of trade).

fields.name: expiretime
fields.doc: Time/Date of order expiration (always expressed in UTC (Universal Time Coordinated, also known as "GMT")

fields.name: curruuid
fields.doc: The message's identity: the UUIDv7 its instant and its code derive.

fields.name: crossuuid
fields.doc: The identity every message of one lifecycle shares, derived from the identifier they share; the message's own where it names none.

fields.name: crosscode
fields.doc: The identifier every message of one lifecycle shares: OrderID, else ClOrdID, OrigClOrdID, QuoteID, QuoteReqID or MDReqID, the first stated.

fields.name: hashcode
fields.doc: The XXH3-64 of what the event states and the named FIX content behind it.

fields.name: crosshashcode
fields.doc: The XXH3-64 of the cross code; zero where the message names none.

fields.name: prevuuid
fields.doc: The identity of the message this one follows, where it follows one.

fields.name: seqnum
fields.doc: The message's place in its chain: how many came before it.

fields.name: parentuuids
fields.doc: The identities of the messages this one descends from, in the order it states them.

fields.name: identifiers
fields.doc: The names this message goes by, each under the canonical name of the field that stated it, in sorted order; repeating-group members are not flattened.

fields.name: beginstring
fields.doc: Identifies beginning of new message and session protocol version by means of a session profile identifier (see FIX Session Layer for details). ALWAYS FIRST FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted).

fields.name: msgtype
fields.doc: Defines message type ALWAYS THIRD FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

fields.name: msgseqnum
fields.doc: Integer message sequence number.

fields.name: sendercompid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify firm sending message.

fields.name: targetcompid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify receiving firm.

fields.name: possdupflag
fields.doc: Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number

fields.name: msgdirection
fields.doc: Specifies the direction of the message.

fields.name: sourceurl
fields.doc: The object this message's line was read from.

fields.name: pluginid
fields.doc: The plugin that logged the line inside a bridge, as the bridge names it: the row's own pluginid column, never derived.

fields.name: msgctxid
fields.doc: The message context a bridge handled the message in, as its own log names it.

fields.name: msgsessionid
fields.doc: The session instance a bridge handled a line on, as its own row header brackets it - never what the message states about itself.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Ticker symbol. Common, "human understood" representation of the security. SecurityID (48) value can be specified if no symbol exists (e.g. non-exchange traded Collective Investment Vehicles)

fields.name: symbolticker
fields.doc: The ticker the instrument is known by: what Symbol settles on, null where the message names none.

fields.name: securityid
fields.doc: Security identifier value of SecurityIDSource (22) type (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc). Requires SecurityIDSource.

fields.name: securityidsource
fields.doc: Identifies class or source of the SecurityID(48) value.

fields.name: securitytype
fields.doc: Indicates type of security. Security type enumerations are grouped by Product(460) field value. NOTE: Additional values may be used by mutual agreement of the counterparties.

fields.name: securitysubtype
fields.doc: Sub-type qualification/identification of the SecurityType. As an example for SecurityType(167)="REPO", the SecuritySubType="General Collateral" can be used to further specify the type of REPO.

fields.name: securityexchange
fields.doc: Market used to help identify a security.

fields.name: cficode
fields.doc: Indicates the type of security using ISO 10962 standard, Classification of Financial Instruments (CFI code) values. ISO 10962 is maintained by ANNA (Association of National Numbering Agencies) acting as Registration Authority. See "Appendix 6-B FIX Fields Based Upon Other Standards". See also the Product (460) and SecurityType (167) fields. It is recommended that CFICode be used instead of SecurityType (167) for non-Fixed Income instruments.

fields.name: maturitydate
fields.doc: Date of maturity.

fields.name: product
fields.doc: Indicates the type of product the security is associated with. See also the CFICode (461) and SecurityType (167) fields.

fields.name: isincode
fields.doc: The instrument's ISIN: the message's own, else SecurityID or a SecurityAltID whose source is ISIN.

fields.name: cusipcode
fields.doc: The instrument's CUSIP: the message's own, else a SecurityID or SecurityAltID whose source is CUSIP.

fields.name: sedolcode
fields.doc: The instrument's SEDOL: the message's own, else a SecurityID or SecurityAltID whose source is SEDOL.

fields.name: bloombergcode
fields.doc: The instrument's Bloomberg identifier: the message's own, else a SecurityID or SecurityAltID whose source is Bloomberg.

fields.name: miccode
fields.doc: The market the message names, as an ISO 10383 MIC: the message's own, else SecurityExchange, ExDestination or LastMkt.

fields.name: securitytradingstatus
fields.doc: Identifies the trading status applicable to the security.

fields.name: tradsesstatus
fields.doc: State of the trading session.

fields.name: securitystatus
fields.doc: Indicates the current state of the instrument.

fields.name: tradable
fields.doc: Whether the instrument could be traded when the message was sent: SecurityTradingStatus, else TradSesStatus, else SecurityStatus; null where none of them says.

fields.name: account
fields.doc: Account mnemonic as agreed between buy and sell sides, e.g. broker and institution or investor/intermediary and fund manager.

fields.name: clordid
fields.doc: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by the buy-side (institution, broker, intermediary etc.) (identified by SenderCompID(49) or OnBehalfOfCompID(115) as appropriate). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms, particularly those which electronically submit multi-day orders, trade globally or throughout market close periods, should ensure uniqueness across days, for example by embedding a date within the ClOrdID(11) field.

fields.name: origclordid
fields.doc: ClOrdID (11) of the previous order (NOT the initial order of the day) as assigned by the institution, used to identify the previous order in cancel and cancel/replace requests.

fields.name: secondaryclordid
fields.doc: Assigned by the party which originates the order. Can be used to provide the ClOrdID (11) used by an exchange or executing system.

fields.name: orderid
fields.doc: Unique identifier for Order as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN). Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day. Firms which accept multi-day orders should consider embedding a date within the OrderID field to assure uniqueness across days.

fields.name: secondaryorderid
fields.doc: Assigned by the party which accepts the order. Can be used to provide the OrderID (37) used by an exchange or executing system.

fields.name: execid
fields.doc: Unique identifier of execution message as assigned by sell-side (broker, exchange, ECN) (will be 0 (zero) for ExecType (150)=I (Order Status)).

fields.name: tradeid
fields.doc: The unique ID assigned to the trade entity once it is received or matched by the exchange or central counterparty.

fields.name: quotereqid
fields.doc: Unique identifier for a QuoteRequest(35=R).

fields.name: quoteid
fields.doc: Unique identifier for quote

fields.name: quoterespid
fields.doc: Message reference for Quote Response

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Side of order (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

fields.name: px
fields.doc: The price the message is about: Price, else LastPx, else AvgPx, else the price its own side's lane quotes.

fields.name: prevpx
fields.doc: The price stated before this message: PrevClosePx where the message states one, else the price its predecessor in the chain stated.

fields.name: lastpx
fields.doc: Price of this (last) fill.

fields.name: avgpx
fields.doc: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

fields.name: qty
fields.doc: The quantity the message is about: OrderQty, else LastQty, else CumQty, else LeavesQty, else the size its own side's lane quotes.

fields.name: prevqty
fields.doc: The quantity the message's predecessor in the chain stated.

fields.name: lastqty
fields.doc: Quantity (e.g. shares) bought/sold on this (last) fill.

fields.name: cumqty
fields.doc: Total quantity (e.g. number of shares) filled.

fields.name: leavesqty
fields.doc: Quantity open for further execution. If the OrdStatus (39) is Canceled, DoneForTheDay, Expired, Calculated, or Rejected (in which case the order is no longer active) then LeavesQty could be 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty (38) - CumQty (14).

fields.name: unit
fields.doc: The unit the quantity is counted in: UnitOfMeasure.

fields.name: currency
fields.doc: Identifies currency used for price or quantity fields, depending on the asset class being traded. CurrencyCodeSource(2897) may be used to disambiguate the code source scheme used, and ISO 4217 is the default scheme if absent.

fields.name: settlcurrency
fields.doc: Currency code of settlement denomination.

fields.name: qtytype
fields.doc: Type of quantity specified in quantity field. ContractMultiplier (tag 231) is required when QtyType = 1 (Contracts). UnitOfMeasure (tag 996) and TimeUnit (tag 997) are required when QtyType = 2 (Units of Measure per Time Unit).

fields.name: ordtype
fields.doc: Order type.

fields.name: timeinforce
fields.doc: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. Absence of this field is interpreted as DAY. NOTE not applicable to CIV Orders.

fields.name: bidpx
fields.doc: Bid price/rate

fields.name: bidcurrency
fields.doc: The currency the bid lane is quoted in: the message's own Currency, else SettlCurrency.

fields.name: bidunit
fields.doc: The unit the bid lane's size is counted in, where the lane states it.

fields.name: bidsize
fields.doc: Quantity of bid

fields.name: offerpx
fields.doc: Offer price/rate

fields.name: askcurrency
fields.doc: The currency the ask lane is quoted in: the message's own Currency, else SettlCurrency.

fields.name: askunit
fields.doc: The unit the ask lane's size is counted in, where the lane states it.

fields.name: offersize
fields.doc: Quantity of offer

fields.name: state
fields.doc: The state the order is in: OrdStatus, else ExecType, read as one lifecycle vocabulary.

fields.name: ordstatus
fields.doc: Identifies current status of order. *** SOME VALUES HAVE BEEN REPLACED - See "Replaced Features and Supported Approach" *** (see Volume : "Glossary" for value definitions)

fields.name: exectype
fields.doc: Describes the specific ExecutionRpt (e.g. Pending Cancel) while OrdStatus(39) will always identify the current order status (e.g. Partially Filled).

fields.name: quotestatus
fields.doc: Identifies the status of the quote acknowledgement.

fields.name: quoteresponselevel
fields.doc: Level of Response requested from receiver of quote messages. A default value should be bilaterally agreed.

fields.name: quoteentryrejectreason
fields.doc: Reason Quote Entry was rejected:

fields.name: ordrejreason
fields.doc: Code to identify reason for order rejection. Note: Values 3, 4, and 5 will be used when rejecting an order due to pre-allocation information errors.

fields.name: cxlrejreason
fields.doc: Code to identify reason for rejection of cancellation or modification.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Free format text string

fields.name: nopartyids
fields.doc: Number of PartyID (448), PartyIDSource (447), and PartyRole (452) entries

fields.name: parties
partyid
fields.doc: Party identifier/code. See PartyIDSource (447) and PartyRole (452).

fields.name: partyidsource
fields.doc: Identifies class or source of the PartyID (448) value. Required if PartyID is specified. Note: applicable values depend upon PartyRole (452) specified.

fields.name: partyrole
fields.doc: Identifies the type or role of the PartyID (448) specified.

fields.name: partyrolequalifier
fields.doc: Used to further qualify the value of PartyRole(452).

fields.name: nopartysubids
fields.doc: Number of PartySubID (523)and PartySubIDType (803) entries

fields.name: partysubid
fields.doc: Sub-identifier (e.g. Clearing Account for PartyRole (452)=Clearing Firm, Locate ID # for PartyRole=Locate/Lending Firm, etc). Not required when using PartyID (448), PartyIDSource (447), and PartyRole.

fields.name: partysubidtype
fields.doc: Type of PartySubID(523) value.
Repeating group below should contain unique combinations of PartyID, PartyIDSource, and PartyRole

fields.name: nosecurityaltid
fields.doc: Number of SecurityAltID (455) entries.

fields.name: securityaltid
fields.doc: Alternate Security identifier value for this security of SecurityAltIDSource (456) type (e.g. CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, etc). Requires SecurityAltIDSource.

fields.name: securityaltidsource
fields.doc: Identifies class or source of the SecurityAltID(455) value.

fields.name: symbolpositionnumber
fields.doc: Reference to the first or second currency or digital asset in Symbol(55) for FX-style trading.

fields.name: notrdregtimestamps
fields.doc: Number of timestamp entries.

fields.name: trdregtimestamps
trdregtimestamp
fields.doc: Traded / Regulatory timestamp value.

fields.name: trdregtimestamptype
fields.doc: Trading / Regulatory timestamp type.

fields.name: trdregtimestamporigin
fields.doc: Text which identifies the "origin" (i.e. system which was used to generate the timestamp) for the Traded / Regulatory timestamp value.

fields.name: trdregtimestampmanualindicator
fields.doc: Indicates whether a given timestamp was manually captured.

fields.name: desktype
fields.doc: Identifies the type of Trading Desk.

fields.name: desktypesource
fields.doc: Identifies the class or source of DeskType(1033) values. Conditionally required when DeskType(1033) is specified.

fields.name: deskorderhandlinginst
fields.doc: Codes that apply special information that the broker-dealer needs to report.

fields.name: informationbarrierid
fields.doc: The identifier of the information barrier in place for a trading unit that will meet the criteria of the "no-knowledge" exception in FINRA Rule 5320.02.

fields.name: nbboentrytype
fields.doc: Type of NBBO information.

fields.name: nbboprice
fields.doc: Price related to NBBO. NBBOEntryType(2831) may be used to indicate entry type, e.g. bid or offer.

fields.name: nbboqty
fields.doc: Quantity related to NBBO. NBBOEntryType(2831) may be used to indicte entry type, e.g. bid or offer.

fields.name: nbbosource
fields.doc: Source of NBBO information.
Required if NoTrdRegTimestamps(768) > 0.

fields.name: bodylength
fields.doc: Message length, in bytes, forward to the CheckSum field. ALWAYS SECOND FIELD IN MESSAGE. (Always unencrypted)

fields.name: onbehalfofcompid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify firm originating message if the message was delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the SenderCompID field and the firm originating the message in this field.

fields.name: delivertocompid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify the firm targeted to receive the message if the message is delivered by a third party i.e. the third party firm identifier would be delivered in the TargetCompID (56) field and the ultimate receiver firm ID in this field.

fields.name: securedatalen
fields.doc: Length of encrypted message

fields.name: securedata
fields.doc: Actual encrypted data stream

fields.name: sendersubid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (desk, trader, etc.)

fields.name: senderlocationid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

fields.name: targetsubid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify specific individual or unit intended to receive message. "ADMIN" reserved for administrative messages not intended for a specific user.

fields.name: targetlocationid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify specific message destination's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader)

fields.name: onbehalfofsubid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator (i.e. trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

fields.name: onbehalfoflocationid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify specific message originator's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

fields.name: delivertosubid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient (i.e. trader) if the message is delivered by a third party

fields.name: delivertolocationid
fields.doc: Assigned value used to identify specific message recipient's location (i.e. geographic location and/or desk, trader) if the message was delivered by a third party

fields.name: possresend
fields.doc: Indicates that message may contain information that has been sent under another sequence number.

fields.name: xmldatalen
fields.doc: Length of the XmlData data block.

fields.name: xmldata
fields.doc: Actual XML data stream (e.g. FIXML). See appropriate XML reference (e.g. FIXML). Note: may contain embedded SOH characters.

fields.name: signaturelength
fields.doc: Number of bytes in signature field

fields.name: signature
fields.doc: Electronic signature

fields.name: checksum
fields.doc: Three byte, simple checksum (see Volume 2: "Checksum Calculation" for description). ALWAYS LAST FIELD IN MESSAGE; i.e. serves, with the trailing <SOH>, as the end-of-message delimiter. Always defined as three characters. (Always unencrypted)

fields.name: metadata
fields.doc: What a bridge stated under its own namespaces - a `TECH.` or an `AMON.` key - each under the key as the bridge spelled it, folded, in sorted order.

fields.name: nofixentries
fields.doc: How many pairs the message carried, in arrival order.

fields.name: fixentries
fields.doc: Every pair the message carried, in arrival order, beside what the dictionary made of it.
